component.name: TripleWrapper
component.summary: Smart archive manager with intelligent storage decisions

description.p: TripleWrapper is a modern archive manager for Linux that combines the simplicity of GNOME Disks with the real-time performance monitoring of Steam's download graph.

ul.li: Smart storage decisions: Automatically detects if there's enough space for safe in-place rewriting, and redirects to external drives when needed
Real-time telemetry: Steam-style graph showing read/write/compression speeds in MB/s
Safe operations: In-place safe principle - original file never modified until new version is verified with checksums
Native GTK4/Libadwaita: Integrates perfectly with GNOME and other GTK desktops
Multiple formats: Supports 7z, ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ, TAR.XZ, TAR.ZST, TAR.BZ2, Pixz
Flatpak sandboxed: Secure by default with explicit filesystem permissions

description.p: Built on top of proven command-line tools (7z, tar, pixz) with a modern Rust core and Python/GTK4 frontend.

screenshot.caption: Main window showing archive analysis with storage breakdown

description.p: First stable release: local-only archive manager with smart storage decisions, real-time telemetry, AES support and Flatpak distribution
